name: Breeze icons (a subset)
where: icons of the menus and toolbars
url: the SVG files themselves, in resources/icons of the Quillbinder source (https://github.com/Shelin-boop/Quillbinder_Collection); upstream: https://invent.kde.org/frameworks/breeze-icons

name: Monocypher
where: the check of package signatures (Ed25519), compiled into the program (0.65.0)
url: src/core/third_party/monocypher of the Quillbinder source (https://github.com/Shelin-boop/Quillbinder_Collection); upstream: https://github.com/LoupVaillant/Monocypher, tag 4.0.3

name: Botan
where: the cryptography of the built-in encryption (OpenPGP, through RNP), compiled into the program (0.99.0)

name: RNP (with sexpp)
license: BSD-2-Clause, BSD-3-Clause, Apache-2.0 and MIT parts
where: the OpenPGP code of the built-in encryption, with its S-expression library sexpp, compiled into the program (0.99.0)
url: https://github.com/rnpgp/rnp, tag v0.18.1 (commit aad1892e4d8423398a0b973bd0a7e4544c359afc), and https://github.com/rnpgp/sexpp (commit c641a2f36520bab783657a58650d9fda548b9dec); built by tools/get-crypto.sh

name: json-c
where: reading and writing JSON for RNP, compiled into the program (0.99.0)
url: https://github.com/json-c/json-c, tag json-c-0.19-20260627 (commit aa716cd8d663c976b99b0f30f102ee1d8ef63146); built by tools/get-crypto.sh

name: bzip2
where: reading bzip2-compressed OpenPGP data for RNP, compiled into the program (0.99.0)
url: https://sourceware.org/bzip2/ (the sources as the libarchive project mirrors them: https://github.com/libarchive/bzip2, tag bzip2-1.0.8, commit 6a8690fc8d26c815e798c588f796eabe9d684cf0); built by tools/get-crypto.sh

name: QtKeychain
where: keeping the passwords of the built-in encryption in the system's key store, linked into the program (0.99.0)
url: https://github.com/frankosterfeld/qtkeychain, tag 0.18.0 (commit e86bc3cbb50b172be61ed857803a372412b6ad85); vendored in src/third_party/qtkeychain (README.txt there names its one change)

name: EFF large word list
where: the words of the passphrases the built-in encryption suggests (7,776 English words), inside the program (0.99.0)

name: AppImage type2-runtime
where: the start code at the beginning of the AppImage file
